subject: Final Go/No-Go: MAP acceptance criteria, signer sequencing, and preferred start window
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@novaretail.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Kramer <alex.kramer@novaretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novaretail.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP acceptance & timing questions

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We're close on internal alignment but need to lock three things before we can pull the trigger:

1) Clear pass/fail criteria for the evaluation (MAP acceptance) — engineering needs an objective checklist.
2) Signature sequencing — Procurement wants an order for signers so they can book calendars (we have two signers on our side and Legal on ours).
3) Start date window — we prefer a mid-September start but need to confirm when Redwood can guarantee onboarding support and an initial SLA for Dedicated capacity.

Can you share a short timeline that shows approvals, the Esign flow, and realistic sign-off timing? Also attach the latest MAP and SOW draft so our legal and procurement can review in parallel.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
VP Product, NovaRetail

[attachment: evaluation-radar.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novaretail.com>
Cc: Alex Kramer <alex.kramer@novaretail.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP acceptance & timing questions

Samira — thanks, great set of asks. Putting the short timeline and sign sequence below and attaching the MAP and SOW drafts. High-level summary first, then granular gates.

High-level (fast path):
- MAP acceptance checklist completed by NovaRetail engineering (5 business days from access to eval environment).
- Legal & Procurement redline review (internal standard: 3 business days).
- DocuSign route: NovaRetail signer 1 -> NovaRetail signer 2 -> Redwood legal
- Target execution: signatures within 10 business days from circulation (faster if no material redlines).
- Preferred start window: onboarding kickoff by 2027-09-12 with Dedicated capacity baseline available for initial ramp.

Key gating items (pass/fail):
1) Feature coverage: test prompts in MAP v2 must hit 90% of target intents with no critical hallucination paths.
2) Latency SLO: 99th percentile <= 450ms on the evaluation workload.
3) Data isolation: VPC & KMS configuration validated by NovaRetail security.
4) Regression tolerance: automated evals show no quality regression vs baseline model by >1.5% on MAP metrics.

Attachments: MAP-v2.pdf, SOW-draft-Redwood-NovaRetail.docx, signature-sequence.xlsx

Next steps I'm proposing:
- We (Redwood) will provision a dedicated eval pool by tomorrow evening.
- Samira, share the engineer(s) who will run the MAP tests and an estimated calendar availability.
- Marissa/Ben, can you confirm the standard DocuSign template to use and whether we can accept the NovaRetail procurement SLA exception request (if any)?

I'll stay on the thread while your procurement team circulates.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

[attachment: MAP-v2.pdf (PDF); attachment: SOW-draft-Redwood-NovaRetail.docx (DOCX); attachment: signature-sequence.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Final MAP acceptance & timing questions

Thanks Sean — quick internal note for procurement/legal sequencing.

Ben: we can use our standard enterprise e-sign flow (Redwood Legal last signature) — that aligns with Samira's request. If NovaRetail pushes a non-standard SLA clause, we should flag the specific paragraph and propose a carve to Appendix B rather than accepting a global change.

Ben: can you confirm whether the SOW draft requires any commercial redlines (discounts, credits for missed SLO) beyond our standard playbook? If not, we can aim for the 10 business day execution target.

Operational readiness: Irene, engineering will need to reserve the Dedicated pool for the onboarding week. Can you confirm GPU availability for the week of 2027-09-12 and whether we can pre-stage a warm cache to lower first-week latency?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions & Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Samira / team — quick procurement/legal confirmation from our side:

1) Signature flow: we're good with NovaRetail signer 1 -> signer 2 -> Redwood legal (final). We'll prepare DocuSign with visible routing and an ETA of 2 business days to set up once we get signers' emails.
2) Commercial redlines: current SOW includes standard credits for missed SLOs (see section 4). If NovaRetail requests any additional credits or bespoke SLA language beyond the standard, we'll need commercial approval (estimate 1–2 business days).
3) Execution ramp & start date: engineering (Irene) confirms Dedicated capacity can be reserved for week of 2027-09-12. We can pre-stage model artifacts to reduce first-week cold-starts but we'll need the eval MAP passes completed at least 3 business days before kickoff to finalize warm caches.

Proposed tight timeline (fast path):
- 2027-08-02: Redwood provisions eval pool.
- 2027-08-02 to 2027-08-09: NovaRetail runs MAP tests and circulates redlines.
- 2027-08-10 to 2027-08-13: Legal/procurement review + DocuSign setup.
- 2027-08-16: Target signature initiation.
- Signers complete within 5 business days of initiation (target execution by 2027-08-23).
- Onboarding kickoff target: 2027-09-12.

If any heavy redlines arrive, plan slides out by ~2 weeks.

Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

Samira / Alex — short, actionable plan below so your procurement and engineering teams have a single source of truth. Please confirm receipt and signers' emails so we can push the DocuSign envelope.

Fast path (confirmed):
- Eval environment live: 2027-08-02 (provisioned by Redwood).
- MAP acceptance window: 2027-08-02 to 2027-08-09. Objective checklist (see attached MAP-v2.pdf).
- Legal/procurement review window: 2027-08-10 to 2027-08-13.
- DocuSign circulation: initiate on 2027-08-16. Routing: NovaRetail signer 1 -> NovaRetail signer 2 -> Redwood Legal (final).
- Target signature completion: by 2027-08-23 (5 business days from initiation).
- Reserve Dedicated onboarding week: 2027-09-12. We will pre-stage model artifacts if MAP passes are green by 2027-09-07.

Critical yes/no gating for Go:
- YES if MAP pass criteria (feature coverage, latency SLO, security validation) are met and no material commercial redlines are required.
- NO if the MAP shows >1.5% regression in quality, latency fails 99p SLO, or a legal clause requires platform-level change.

Attachments included again for ease of circulation: MAP-v2.pdf, SOW-draft-Redwood-NovaRetail.docx, signature-sequence.xlsx

Action items for NovaRetail:
- Reply with the primary engineer who will run the MAP and their email.
- Confirm two signers' names and emails for DocuSign.
- Indicate whether mid-September onboarding works if we hit the fast path.

I'll keep a running tracker in HubSpot and stay on-call during the review windows.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
